verdict.rationale: Pigment documents building planning models, bringing in data through native connectors and scheduled imports, and running variance analysis on the same platform as the budget, which covers the generic plan-vs-actuals core. Nothing in the evidence names revenue planning, CRM pipeline sources, or subscription data. Missing for 10: explicit revenue-plan documentation, named CRM (e.g. pipeline) or subscription-billing connectors, revenue-specific plan-vs-actuals tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build a revenue plan from CRM pipeline or subscription data and track it against actuals

citations.quote: The Modeler Agent builds, maintains, and optimizes planning models from natural language intent.
